mapper.sql: select c.id as id, c.change_no as change_no, c.team_id as team_id, t.team_no as team_no, t.team_name as team_name, c.division_id as division_id, d.division_name as division_name, t.division_id as team_division_id, td.division_name as team_division_name, c.registration_id as registration_id, c.change_type as change_type, c.subject_player_id as subject_player_id, coalesce(mp.nickname, p.game_nickname) as subject_name, p.player_no as subject_player_no, c.initiator_role as initiator_role, coalesce(imp.nickname, '') as initiator_name, c.change_status as change_status, c.effect_stage as effect_stage, c.impact_summary as impact_summary, c.before_summary as before_summary, c.after_summary as after_summary, c.create_time as create_time, c.audit_time as audit_time, c.effective_time as effective_time, c.audit_user_name as audit_user_name, c.audit_remark as audit_remark, 0 as legacy_record from basket_team_membership_change c left join basket_team t on t.id = c.team_id left join basket_division d on d.id = c.division_id left join basket_division td on td.id = t.division_id left join basket_player_profile p on p.id = c.subject_player_id and p.is_delete = 0 left join basket_member_profile mp on mp.member_id = c.subject_member_id and mp.is_delete = 0 left join basket_member_profile imp on imp.member_id = c.initiator_member_id and imp.is_delete = 0 where c.is_delete = 0

select null as id, i.invitation_no as change_no, i.team_id as team_id, t.team_no as team_no, t.team_name as team_name, null as division_id, '待核实' as division_name, t.division_id as team_division_id, td.division_name as team_division_name, null as registration_id, 'INVITE_JOIN' as change_type, i.invitee_player_id as subject_player_id, coalesce(mp.nickname, p.game_nickname) as subject_name, p.player_no as subject_player_no, 'CAPTAIN' as initiator_role, coalesce(imp.nickname, '') as initiator_name, case i.invitation_status when 0 then 'PENDING_USER' when 2 then 'REJECTED' when 3 then 'EXPIRED' when 4 then 'CANCELLED' else 'HISTORICAL' end as change_status, null as effect_stage, '上线前邀请记录，没有管理员审批，不补造审核结论' as impact_summary, '不在队' as before_summary, case when i.invitation_status = 1 then '当时已接受并直接入队' else '未入队' end as after_summary, i.create_time as create_time, null as audit_time, i.responded_time as effective_time, null as audit_user_name, null as audit_remark, 1 as legacy_record from basket_team_invitation i left join basket_team t on t.id = i.team_id left join basket_division td on td.id = t.division_id left join basket_player_profile p on p.id = i.invitee_player_id and p.is_delete = 0 left join basket_member_profile mp on mp.member_id = i.invitee_member_id and mp.is_delete = 0 left join basket_member_profile imp on imp.member_id = i.inviter_member_id and imp.is_delete = 0 where i.is_delete = 0 and not exists ( select 1 from basket_team_membership_change x where x.is_delete = 0 and x.source_biz_type = 'INVITATION' and x.source_biz_id = i.id )

select null as id, concat('LEGACY-MB-', m.id) as change_no, m.team_id as team_id, t.team_no as team_no, t.team_name as team_name, m.division_id as division_id, coalesce(d.division_name, '待核实') as division_name, t.division_id as team_division_id, td.division_name as team_division_name, null as registration_id, case when m.membership_status = 0 then 'VOLUNTARY_LEAVE' else 'CAPTAIN_REMOVE' end as change_type, m.player_id as subject_player_id, coalesce(mp.nickname, p.game_nickname) as subject_name, p.player_no as subject_player_no, case when m.membership_status = 0 then 'PLAYER' else 'CAPTAIN' end as initiator_role, '' as initiator_name, 'HISTORICAL' as change_status, null as effect_stage, '上线前离队留痕，只有成员关系，没有管理员审批' as impact_summary, '曾在队' as before_summary, coalesce(m.leave_reason, '已离队') as after_summary, coalesce(m.leave_time, m.update_time) as create_time, null as audit_time, m.leave_time as effective_time, null as audit_user_name, null as audit_remark, 1 as legacy_record from basket_team_member m left join basket_team t on t.id = m.team_id left join basket_division d on d.id = m.division_id left join basket_division td on td.id = t.division_id left join basket_player_profile p on p.id = m.player_id and p.is_delete = 0 left join basket_member_profile mp on mp.member_id = m.member_id and mp.is_delete = 0 where m.is_delete = 0 and m.is_current = 0 and m.membership_status in (0, 2) and m.leave_time is not null and not exists ( select 1 from basket_team_membership_change x where x.is_delete = 0 and x.source_biz_type = 'TEAM_MEMBER' and x.source_biz_id = m.id )

select * from (
union all
union all
) u
and u.team_no like concat('%', #{teamNo}, '%')
and u.team_name like concat('%', #{teamName}, '%')
and u.division_name like concat('%', #{divisionName}, '%')
and u.change_status = #{changeStatus}
and u.change_type = #{changeType}
and (u.subject_name like concat('%', #{playerKeyword}, '%') or u.subject_player_no like concat('%', #{playerKeyword}, '%'))
order by u.create_time desc, u.change_no desc

select c.id as id, c.change_no as change_no, c.team_id as team_id, t.team_no as team_no, t.team_name as team_name, c.division_id as division_id, d.division_name as division_name, t.division_id as team_division_id, td.division_name as team_division_name, c.registration_id as registration_id, c.change_type as change_type, c.subject_player_id as subject_player_id, c.subject_member_id as subject_member_id, coalesce(mp.nickname, p.game_nickname) as subject_name, p.player_no as subject_player_no, p.certification_status as certification_status, c.initiator_role as initiator_role, coalesce(imp.nickname, '') as initiator_name, c.change_status as change_status, c.effect_stage as effect_stage, c.impact_summary as impact_summary, c.before_summary as before_summary, c.after_summary as after_summary, c.create_time as create_time, c.audit_time as audit_time, c.effective_time as effective_time, c.audit_user_name as audit_user_name, c.audit_remark as audit_remark, 0 as legacy_record from basket_team_membership_change c left join basket_team t on t.id = c.team_id left join basket_division d on d.id = c.division_id left join basket_division td on td.id = t.division_id left join basket_player_profile p on p.id = c.subject_player_id and p.is_delete = 0 left join basket_member_profile mp on mp.member_id = c.subject_member_id and mp.is_delete = 0 left join basket_member_profile imp on imp.member_id = c.initiator_member_id and imp.is_delete = 0 where c.id = #{id} and c.is_delete = 0
select * from basket_team_membership_change where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
select * from basket_team_membership_change where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0 for update
select count(1) from basket_team_membership_change where is_delete = 0 and change_status = 'PENDING_ADMIN'
mapper.update: update basket_team_membership_change set change_status = 'APPROVED', audit_user_id = #{auditUserId}, audit_user_name = #{auditUserName}, audit_remark = #{auditRemark}, audit_time = #{auditTime}, effective_time = #{auditTime}, effect_stage = #{effectStage}, impact_summary = #{impactSummary}, update_time = #{auditTime} where id = #{id} and change_status = 'PENDING_ADMIN' and is_delete = 0

update basket_team_membership_change set change_status = 'REJECTED', audit_user_id = #{auditUserId}, audit_user_name = #{auditUserName}, audit_remark = #{auditRemark}, audit_time = #{auditTime}, update_time = #{auditTime} where id = #{id} and change_status = 'PENDING_ADMIN' and is_delete = 0
update basket_team_invitation set invitation_status = #{status}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
